# Case-insensitive substrings that must never appear in this public
# repository, because they'd name a real service/product running on the
# owner's private infrastructure rather than describing it generically
# (see docs/security.md, "Network architecture"). Checked by
# .github/workflows/repo-guard.yml on every push and pull request.
#
# Add a new line here whenever a future feature (e.g. a services dashboard)
# risks reintroducing a real internal service/product name, hostname, or
# other infrastructure detail that was deliberately generalized in docs/.
# One pattern per line. Lines starting with # are comments and blank lines
# are ignored.

proxmox
home assistant
homeassistant
raspberry pi
raspberrypi

# Bare "Pi" shorthand for Raspberry Pi has slipped in before (docs written
# after a physical-acceptance pass tend to say "the Pi" instead of spelling
# it out). These common phrasings catch that without flagging unrelated
# words like "picture" or "pipeline".
the pi,
the pi.
the pi 
pi's

# The owner's personal domain — was previously the bundle-ID prefix
# (pw.friberg.eve), replaced with the generic com.eve-app. Also blocks the
# domain reappearing anywhere else (docs, comments, etc.).
friberg
